title: Tell HMRC an entity liable for the Economic Crime Levy has become insolvent
text:
Use this online form if an organisation or individual liable for the Economic Crime Levy becomes insolvent. You can:

 • submit the relevant returns whether the registered business continues to trade or not

 • cancel their registration for the Economic Crime Levy

 Who can use this form

 You can use the online form if you’re appointed as:

 • a trustee in bankruptcy or sequestration

 • a liquidator

 • an administrator

 Before you start

 To use this form you’ll need the:

 • name of the organisation or individual

 • business address

 • Economic Crime Levy registration number

 • type of insolvency

 • date when the business became subject to the insolvency procedure

 • deregistration date

 The types of insolvency include:

 • administration

 • members’ voluntary liquidation

 • creditors’ voluntary liquidation

 • compulsory liquidation

 • individual insolvency such as bankruptcy or sequestration

 How to cancel

 You’ll need to sign in to cancel the registration online. You can use either:

 • your sign in details — you can create these if you do not have them

 • your email address — you will get a confirmation code that you can use to sign in

 Start now 

 What happens next

 You will get a reference number and an email confirmation.

 We should deal with your form within 28 working days. We’ll contact you if we need further information.
